{"reason":"Change the medium/high fallback from alternative supplier to alert-planner. The 34 switches cost 45,000 each; alert-planner costs 35,000 and always arrives, saving 340,000 before stockouts. Failure rows at 2.8 and 5.3 inventory-days had stockouts, so this fallback cannot worsen timing and should eliminate those two.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high))
          (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
